standard.summary: 每隔多少步算一次 SVD。
standard.effect: 默认 500。设小于 1 的值启动直接报错。
standard.whenToUse: 默认够用；想更细的曲线就调小（开销增大）。

standard_en.effect: Default 500. Values below 1 fail closed at startup.
standard_en.whenToUse: Default is fine; lower it for finer curves (more overhead).
standard_en.avoidWhen: Very small values slow training down.
